method.coherence: Read 20 unique A/B chunks at the 10 frozen positions; C has identical B chunk IDs/text and receives paired labels. Labels assess actual text, not string-match Hit.
method.grounding: Read all unique A/B top-3 test contexts and source references; verify C top-3 IDs/order identical to B. Score content sufficiency separately from exact-quote Hit. Q04/A uses combined evidence.
method.metadata: Inspected source pages and publication metadata against manifest, normalized physical pages, and character offsets across all 45 test hit records (student review with AI-assisted deterministic checks).
method.filter: Check all three retrieved metadata payloads against the year explicitly present in each of the five filter questions. A/B do not enforce a filter; observed compliance is still reported.
method.limitations: Self-assessed by the author with AI assistance; not blinded to retrieval metrics. Small, prefix-biased coherence sample and five shared-topic test questions.
